newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - America Online a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - America Online a buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it started coverage of America Online with a buy rating.

-- The investment firm said it expects the online services company to report strong results today for its fiscal third quarter, ending March 31. Hambrecht forecasts a loss of $0.05/shr on sales of $455 million in the quarter.
-- Hambrecht forecasts a fiscal year 1997 loss of $0.36/shr on sales of $1.7 bln growing to a profit of $0.78/shr on sales of $2.4 bln in fiscal 1998.
-- In a statement, Hambrecht said AOL remains one of the best known and most used online services available.
-- It can offer advertisers over 8.0 million subscribers, and it has plans to grow its worldwide membership base at the rate of 3.0 million subscribers per year.
-- Lastly, Hambrecht said it had put "the majority" of its connectivity problems behind it and is again poised to grow its subscriber base.
